# Migrate to a storage provider

@include "@global/vagrant-eol.mdx"

HCP Vagrant Registry is being deprecated. Use these guides to migrate your boxes and metadata from HCP Vagrant Registry to another storage provider.

Each guide describes preparing your boxes, moving them to the target provider, and updating your Vagrantfiles to reference the new location.

- [Amazon S3](/vagrant/vagrant-cloud/hcp-vagrant/storage-providers/aws)
- [Azure Blob Storage](/vagrant/vagrant-cloud/hcp-vagrant/storage-providers/azure)
- [IBM Cloud Object Storage](/vagrant/vagrant-cloud/hcp-vagrant/storage-providers/ibm-cloud)
